metadata.description: Documented ground-truth test benchmark annotations for urban pedestrian obstructions in Bengaluru.

benchmark_audit.academic_validity_note: Benchmark uses 6 legacy COCO classes: person, car, motorcycle, umbrella, chair, bench. It lacks custom classes: vendor_cart, construction_debris, commercial_signboard, shop_extension. Coordinates are absolute pixels [x, y, w, h] rather than normalized [0.0, 1.0]. Requires re-annotation and normalization to serve as formal ground truth.
